beliefs: The box reverses the order of characters in the input string [E1]
Reversal preserves case, digits, punctuation, and spaces exactly, only order changes [E1]
Whitespace-only strings (spaces, tabs, newlines) map to empty string, not to themselves [E2]
Leading and trailing spaces are stripped from the input before reversal, so ' a' -> 'a ' and 'a ' -> 'a' [E2]
Internal spaces are preserved during reversal, e.g. 'a  b' -> 'b  a' [E2]
notes: E2 shows whitespace-only inputs give empty output and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed before reversing (so ' a' -> 'a ', 'a ' -> 'a', ' x ' -> 'x '). I strip the input then reverse it; whitespace-only becomes empty.
